name: United Korea
concept: The two Korean states become one country again, by agreement or by force.

name: Gran Colombia
concept: Bolívar's republic of the northern Andes and the isthmus is restored as one federal state.

name: Federal Republic of Central America
concept: The five republics of the isthmus rejoin the federation they formed after independence from Spain.

name: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata
concept: The lands of the old Spanish viceroyalty of the River Plate unite under Buenos Aires again.

name: Union of South American Nations
concept: All twelve South American republics merge into one continental federation with a single parliament and currency.

name: West Indies Federation
concept: The English-speaking Caribbean islands revive the short-lived federation of 1958-1962.

name: United Ireland
concept: Northern Ireland leaves the United Kingdom and joins the Republic, making the whole island one state.

name: Kalmar Union
concept: Denmark, Norway and Sweden join under one crown again, as in the medieval Kalmar Union.

name: Nordic Federation
concept: The five Nordic states pool their defence, currency and foreign policy in a single federation.

name: Baltic Federation
concept: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania merge into one federal state on the Baltic coast.

name: Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth
concept: Poland and Lithuania revive their old union as one Commonwealth of two nations.

name: Intermarium
concept: A federation of the lands between the Baltic and the Black Sea, led by Poland and Ukraine, in the spirit of Piłsudski's plan.

name: Union State of Russia and Belarus
concept: The 1999 Union State treaty is carried through into a real single state with one government.

name: Greater Romania
concept: Romania and Moldova unite, as Romanian and Moldovan unionists propose.

name: Czechoslovakia
concept: The Czech Republic and Slovakia undo the 1993 split and become one federal state again.

name: Austria-Hungary
concept: Austria and Hungary rebuild their dual union as a modern two-part federation.

name: Danubian Federation
concept: The states of the middle Danube form a federation of equals, as liberal reformers proposed before 1914.

name: Yugoslavia
concept: The former Yugoslav republics reunite in a new South Slav federation.

name: Balkan Federation
concept: Yugoslavia, Bulgaria and Albania join in the Balkan federation Tito and Dimitrov discussed in 1947.

name: Benelux Union
concept: Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg turn their customs union into one federal state.

name: Iberian Union
concept: Spain and Portugal join as one federation covering the whole peninsula.

name: European Federation
concept: The European Union becomes a single federal state with one government, army and foreign policy.

name: United Cyprus
concept: The Republic of Cyprus and the Turkish Cypriot north agree to reunite the island in a bicommunal federation.

name: Albania-Kosovo Union
concept: Albania and Kosovo merge by referendum into one Albanian state.

name: Transcaucasian Federation
concept: Georgia, Armenia and Azerbaijan revive the short-lived 1918 South Caucasus federation.

name: Central Asian Union
concept: The five Central Asian republics unite, as Kazakhstan proposed in 2005.

name: Indochinese Federation
concept: Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia form one federation across the Mekong lands.

name: Federation of Malaysia
concept: Malaysia, Singapore and Brunei form the wider Malaysia planned in 1963.

name: United Arab Republic
concept: Egypt and Syria restore Nasser's 1958 union as one republic.

name: Federation of Arab Republics
concept: Egypt, Libya and Syria form the federation they founded in 1972, with real common institutions this time.

name: United Arab Nation
concept: One Arab state from the Atlantic to the Gulf, the pan-Arab dream of Nasserists and Ba'athists.

name: Gulf Union
concept: The six Gulf Cooperation Council monarchies merge into one union, as Saudi Arabia proposed in 2011.

name: Maghreb Union
concept: The states of North Africa's west turn the Arab Maghreb Union into one political union.

name: Greater Somalia
concept: All the Somali-inhabited lands of the Horn of Africa unite under one Somali state, the five points of the Somali star.

name: East African Federation
concept: The core East African Community states carry out their long-planned political federation.

name: Mali Federation
concept: Senegal and Mali re-form the federation they founded at independence in 1959-1960.

name: Confederation of Sahel States
concept: Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger turn their 2024 confederation into one united Sahelian state.
